finalProject.title: KusinAI – Kusina ni Nanay
finalProject.description: KusinAI is a Filipino recipe chatbot that uses Sentence-BERT and rule-based retrieval to provide relevant Filipino recipes.
objectives: Improve the accessibility of home-cooked Filipino recipes.
Use retrieval methods to provide relevant recipes through a chatbot.
finalProject.contribution: The recipe collection was sourced from my mother's cookbook.
finalProject.reflection: Developed a better understanding of chatbot development and information retrieval methods, particularly the importance of preparing and cleaning a reliable dataset.
finalProject.results: Both retrieval methods achieved the same performance score.
